## Decision rule (pilot prioritization, PROTOCOL §C)
- E_R vs D_R latent -1.0% [-3.1, +0.8]; E_R better than A and B (CIs below 0): True; clear LPIPS regression: False.
- **Useful joint-training signal (≥ 5% lower latent MSE vs D_R, CI below 0, better than A/B, no LPIPS regression): False.**
- Rollout term credited (E_R also beats E_L): False.
- Smaller or uncertain effects are inconclusive. A flat result means this pilot did not establish integration; it does not show that no combination can work.
